The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **2** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 1ed33609731b0bc3b2da81c97242e9c8582d003d` → `packageMentionDocs`.

```sh

git fetch origin 4046c96620112657b99fe797c308ed670c0d5c2d && git checkout 4046c96620112657b99fe797c308ed670c0d5c2d

git fetch origin 1ed33609731b0bc3b2da81c97242e9c8582d003d b09ea62c764f4d63a128b14220f87b00f4254be3 && git checkout -B drift-repro 1ed33609731b0bc3b2da81c97242e9c8582d003d && git merge --no-ff b09ea62c764f4d63a128b14220f87b00f4254be3
```

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `b09ea62c764f4d63a128b14220f87b00f4254be3`
Local-runs: none
Scope: packages/services/service-datasource/src/external-datasource-service.ts, packages/services/service-datasource/src/admin-routes.ts, packages/services/service-datasource/src/__tests__/saved-datasource-test-unknown-name.test.ts, packages/services/service-datasource/src/__tests__/primary-datasource-test-and-sync.test.ts, packages/services/service-datasource/src/__tests__/saved-datasource-test-after-failed-connect.test.ts + packages/services/service-datasource/src/plugin.ts (`liveDriver`, `getDatasource` wiring), packages/services/service-datasource/src/datasource-admin-plugin.ts (`getDatasourceRecord`, `servedOrigin`), packages/services/service-datasource/src/datasource-admin-service.ts (`datasourceNotFoundError`, `getDatasource`), packages/services/service-datasource/src/datasource-connection-service.ts (`DEFAULT_DATASOURCE_NAME`, `registeredDriverName`, `attemptConnect`), packages/services/service-datasource/src/datasource-route-ledger.ts and its conformance test, packages/services/service-datasource/src/index.ts and package.json `exports`, packages/services/service-datasource/src/__tests__/datasource-unknown-name.test.ts, packages/plugins/plugin-hono-server/src/adapter.ts (`readRouteParams`) with hono 4.13.12 `request.js`, packages/core/src/fallbacks/memory-metadata.ts, packages/runtime/src/app-plugin.ts and default-datasource-plugin.ts (`registerInMemory('datasource', …)`), ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/datasource/DatasourceResourcePage.tsx (the console caller), precedent commit `6279efef6f` (.changeset/26641-explain-unknown-user-refused.md).

Face: `narrowing` (`Clause-②: no (narrowing)` on the PR body and the changeset). Inputs: card #27510 body, triage 6495190501, claim 6496102898, amendment 6498154139, os-dev-reports 6498107334 and 6499695437; PR #27574 title, body, file list; `git diff origin/main...b09ea62c` read in the detached main tree (merge-base `881af5d2de`); the head's check-runs read at 2026-10-29T14:42Z: 52 runs, all `completed`, 0 failures (success or skipped; the two `skipped` re-runs of Auto Label and Check PR Size at 14:40Z follow the body edit and sit beside their earlier `success` runs). PR author `objectstack-fleet[bot]` (relay write): no off-relay note owed.

### ① Derived judgments

1. **The narrowing, as the tree does it.** `ExternalDatasourceService.testConnection(name)` now opens with `if (name !== DEFAULT_DATASOURCE_NAME && !(await this.config.getDatasource(name))) throw datasourceNotFoundError(name)`, placed BEFORE the method's `try`. `config.getDatasource` is the required member the plugin wires to `metadata()?.get('datasource', n)` (plugin.ts:181), the same read `getDatasourceRecord` makes for the sibling doors (datasource-admin-plugin.ts:413). The thrown error carries `status 404` + `code 'RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND'` + the message `Datasource "NAME" does not exist.`, and `badRequest` (admin-routes.ts:651) relays exactly that pair as `404 RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND`. That is the same status, code and words `GET /datasources/:name` writes inline (admin-routes.ts:749) and the admin service's own `datasourceNotFoundError` (datasource-admin-service.ts:346) throws for PATCH, DELETE and migrate-credential. **Right**: the narrowing is exactly "a non-primary name with no stored record: 200 {ok:false} → 404 RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND".
2. **Nothing else that answered 200 is now refused.** Every path after the guard is byte-identical to main: a stored datasource with a live driver is probed (`checkHealth` or `introspect`), one with no live driver and a failed verdict answers the verdict's reason, one with no live driver and no verdict falls to `introspect` and its engine sentence; every one of those still returns `{ok:false}` inside the `try`, never throws. The primary name `default` skips the lookup entirely, so a `default` with or without a stored record is probed as before. **Right.**
3. **Public surface of `@objectstack/service-datasource`.** `exports` map (`.` and `./contracts`) and `src/index.ts` are unchanged on the head; the new `datasourceNotFoundError` in external-datasource-service.ts is module-private (no `export`), so no helper is published. The one published surface that moves is the in-process `ExternalDatasourceService.testConnection` (class exported from `.`): it gains a throw path for a name with no record, which is a narrowing of its accept set and is named verbatim in the Clause-② line. Its return type is untouched. **Right, and the declaration covers it.**
4. **Host with no `metadata` service.** `metadata()` is `undefined` ⇒ `getDatasource` resolves `undefined` ⇒ every non-`default` name answers 404 at Test. `GET /datasources/:name` and the list already answer 404 / empty in that host (`getDatasourceRecord` and `listDatasourceRecords` read the same optional service). The door now agrees with its siblings there too. **Right**; see ③.5 for the one shade.
5. **Code-declared datasource that is not a stored record.** In first-party hosts it does not arise: `AppPlugin` registers every `defineStack({ datasources })` entry with `metadata.registerInMemory('datasource', name, …)` (app-plugin.ts:1328-1338) and `DefaultDatasourcePlugin` registers `default` the same way (default-datasource-plugin.ts:288); the kernel's memory fallback implements `registerInMemory` (memory-metadata.ts) so the standalone boot path also lists them. A metadata service without `registerInMemory` leaves code datasources out of the list and out of `GET /:name` already; Test now joins them. **Right**: "exists to the engine but has no record" is exactly what the sibling doors already call unknown.
6. **Fault vs absence.** The guard sits outside the `try`, so a `metadata.get` that THROWS propagates out of `testConnection` as a plain error and `badRequest` answers it `400 EXTERNAL_DATASOURCE_ERROR`, not 404. A store fault is never read as "does not exist", matching the #26801 precedent's stance and `GET /:name`'s own `400 DATASOURCE_ADMIN_ERROR` on a throwing store. **Right.** Noted, not a defect: a store fault now refuses Test for a datasource whose live driver is up, where before Test never consulted the store; that is the price of the lookup and the siblings pay it too.
7. **Order of checks.** `requireDatasourceAdmin` (401/403) and `resolve` (503 when the service is absent) run before the lookup, as at `GET /:name`; an unauthenticated caller learns nothing about which names exist. **Right.**
8. **Route handler and ledger.** `admin-routes.ts` changes two docblocks only; the handler at :756 is unchanged, as the PR says. `datasource-route-ledger.ts` is unchanged; its `POST /:name/test` row states the route's purpose and caller, not its answer, and its conformance test checks presence, not status. **Right.**
9. **Primary name.** `DEFAULT_DATASOURCE_NAME` is the host-reserved `'default'`, the only name `connect` registers `asDefault`; `registeredDriverName` resolves the live driver by that same name test, so the exemption and the probe agree on which datasource is primary. **Right.**

### ② Semver level

- `.changeset/27510-datasource-test-unknown-name-404.md`: `'@objectstack/service-datasource': patch`, title with `!`, `Clause-②: no (narrowing) — …` identical to the PR body's line, `Metadata-protocol: none`, `adr-0087: not-required (no-migration-prescription)` marker, `**BREAKING** accept-set narrowing …` banner with Before / Now / Unchanged / Who sees it / The remedy. This is the #26801 shape (`6279efef6f`, `.changeset/26641-explain-unknown-user-refused.md`: patch, `!`, same marker text pattern, same banner sections) applied to this door. **Matches.**
- The level is right for what the diff publishes: no schema key, export or type moves; the request and the `{ ok, latencyMs, tableCount, error }` answer keep their shape; `Metadata-protocol: none` holds (no `packages/spec` file, no metadata-protocol surface in the diff). A declared narrowing at `patch` with the banner is the repo's precedent and `check-changeset-no-major` / `check-adr-0087-registration` / Check Changeset are green on the head.
- The `Unchanged` bullet's claim "every other outcome of `testConnection` is still returned, never thrown" is true of the tree (①.2). The `Who sees it` bullet names the platform-settings caller; see ③.5 for the host-without-registerInMemory shade it does not name (no action required).

### ③ Boundary flags

1. **File-surface extension (two fixtures).** Amendment 6498154139 adds `primary-datasource-test-and-sync.test.ts` and `saved-datasource-test-after-failed-connect.test.ts` as fixture-only edits. Read: in the first, `ghost` is added to `RECORDS` (never connected, so its Test keeps the "no live driver" subject; the file's list pin at :185 looks up `default` by name, unaffected) and the health-check unit's `getDatasource` returns `{ name }`; in the second, `boot()` returns `records`, the HTTP pin seeds `ghost` before `POST /ghost/test`, and the verdict units' `getDatasource` returns `{ name }`. Every assertion is unchanged. The edits are forced by the fix (those pins drove `/ghost/test` with no record and so pinned the defect) and are exactly the amendment's description. **Answered: accepted.**
2. **`remote-tables` / `object-draft` answer an unknown name 400.** Read: `assertFederationSource` (external-datasource-service.ts:604-606) throws the primary refusal for `default`, then `getDatasource`; an `undefined` record falls into `isFederationSource(undefined) === false` and the not-a-federation-source error (400). It is a real fifth instance of the #25486 family, outside this card's ruling (the triage names only the Test door). **Escalated, not blocking**: the dev marked it "noted, not filed"; the seat should file it as its own card (dedupe words in the report) so the family is closed, since this PR's new docblock at admin-routes.ts:86-89 now says "every `datasource-admin` door that takes `:name` answers it 404 … and so does `POST /datasources/:name/test`", which is true as written (the two 400 doors are `external-datasource` doors) but leaves the reader to notice the carve-out.
3. **`datasource-route-ledger.ts` unchanged.** Right under the claim's own condition (①.8). **Answered.**
4. **Absent-`metadata` host.** Answered at ①.4: Test now agrees with `GET /:name` in that host. **Answered.**
5. **Shade for the record.** A host whose metadata service lacks `registerInMemory` holds no record for code-declared datasources; Test previously probed them by live driver and now answers 404, as list and `GET /:name` already did. No first-party metadata service lacks the member (MetadataManager, memory fallback). Not a finding; the declaration's "a name that resolves no saved datasource" covers it literally.
6. **Dev deviations.** "No Skills-docs line" is superseded: the PR body carries `Skills-docs: none — …` with the grep it rests on; the changeset carries none, as the #26801 changeset carried none. "Commit trailers use the model-free pair" is a process note outside this review's contract face; recorded, no ruling.
7. **`open_questions`**: empty in both reports. **PR author** is `objectstack-fleet[bot]`; no off-relay login to name.
8. **Console caller.** `DatasourceResourcePage.tsx:311-319`: `api()` throws on a non-2xx, so a 404 surfaces as `NAME: Datasource "NAME" does not exist.` in the error toast instead of the former "no registered driver" text; the console only tests names it listed, so this is reached only by a concurrent delete. No consumer change owed.

### ④ Design judgment

- **external-datasource-service.ts** — holds. The lookup is the sibling's lookup (①.1), the exemption is the reserved name (①.9), the guard sits outside the `try` so a store fault stays a fault (①.6), and every other outcome is byte-identical (①.2). Probes: `default` with a record → not looked up, probed by `registeredDriverName` → unchanged; `default` without a record → same; a stored datasource whose driver is down (no live driver, failed verdict) → verdict reason, `200 {ok:false}`; stored, no live driver, no verdict → engine sentence, `200 {ok:false}`; stored and up → `200 {ok:true}`; a name in odd casing → the store's key is the key, identical at `GET /:name`, so both doors agree (404 or found); URL-encoded name → Hono's `param()` percent-decodes (`tryDecodeURIComponent`, hono 4.13.12 request.js:50) and `readRouteParams` passes it through, so `no%20such` is looked up as `no such` at both doors; a metadata read that throws → 400, not 404; the in-process caller gets a throw where it got `{ok:false}` — declared in the Clause-② line, and no in-process caller exists outside the package (grep over packages/ and apps/). **No must-fix.** **Should-fix (non-blocking):** `datasourceNotFoundError` is now a second private copy of the admin service's helper with the same words; the new test holds the two doors' answers equal so drift is caught, but one shared helper (e.g. beside `importNameRefusedError`'s pattern, or exported from one module to the other) would make the 404 envelope one fact instead of a pinned pair. Carry forward, not a condition of this PR.
- **admin-routes.ts** — holds. Docblock-only; both sentences are true of the tree (`badRequest` relays the pair; the throwers now include `testConnection`). The handler is unchanged, so the relay is the one tested at `datasource-unknown-name.test.ts` for the four siblings.
- **saved-datasource-test-unknown-name.test.ts** — holds against the ruling. Real composition (ObjectQL, connection service, driver factory, admin service, `ExternalDatasourceServicePlugin.init`, admin routes on Hono), entitled caller, both services reading the one `records` map. The five pins are the triage's two clauses plus the three controls, and the parity pin compares status, code and message with `GET /:name` for the same name. Red-first and ablations A1/A2 are reported; this record relies on the head's green Test Core, not on the report.
- **primary-datasource-test-and-sync.test.ts**, **saved-datasource-test-after-failed-connect.test.ts** — hold. Fixture records only; assertions unchanged; each edit is commented with the reason and the pinning file (③.1).
